_meta.note: Computed styles of the seven identity components #34 freezes, recorded in a real Chromium. The CI test guards the inputs (component source, tokens.css, globals.css); `identity_styles.py check` re-measures a running app against this file.

why.brand: the filament wordmark and its breathe dot (top-bar.tsx)
why.chip: tone map (incl. signal's --dev-hue fill) is identity; neutral and accent measured live
why.dial: instrument identity: arc, ticks, indicator, readout, unit
why.sectionlabel: explicitly frozen at section-label.tsx:12-23; #16 must not touch it
why.slider: #34 LOW note: prop-driven tinted Slider computed styles, both themes (tint paints only while dragging)
why.statusdot: #15 second channel must survive; frozen only after #15 lands
why.switch: #34 LOW note: prop-driven tinted Switch computed styles, both themes
